CustomField.description: Turns this service on or off, for outgoing and incoming services alike. When unticked, the service is off but its setting is kept. Outbound: the service sends no call. Inbound: the service does not run for an incoming request. For both kinds of service, the Retry actions do not run its failed calls again, and the API Test Harness does not list the service.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Untick to turn this service off without deleting its setting. Outbound: the service sends no call. Inbound: the service does not run for an incoming request. Its failed calls cannot be run again from their API issues.
CustomField.label: Is Active
